text.p: QuesTech Inc said Friday its QuesTech Packaging Inc unit reduced production of baby bottle liners and cut its workforce temporarily pending the resolution of a contractual dispute with its sole distributor.
QuesTech said it was not certain how long production would be curtailed. The dispute involves contract interpretatons, specifications and warranties.

Chairman Vincent Salvatori stated, "We will use this time as an opportunity to concentrate on getting 'online' new equipment which will allow QTPI to diversify beyond its present single product using the Company's patented technology and to increase capacity. We have had serious discussions with Fortune 500 companies to develop and produce several different products made possible by our unique process."
QuesTech provides scientific and engineering services to clients in the fields of command, control and communications and intelligence services.
